metadata.title: New Zealand Hot Springs and Thermal Pools
metadata.description: Consolidated from NZHotPools, Wikipedia, Newswire, HotSpringsGuides, and the Hot Springs of NZ guidebook

properties.name: Ngawha Spa
properties.address: Ngawha Springs Road, Ngawha Springs, Kaikohe

properties.name: Nga Waiariki Ngawha Springs
properties.description: Paid Maori-owned geothermal pool complex near Kaikohe with 16 mineral pools at varying temperatures and colours

properties.name: Waiwera Thermal Resort and Spa
properties.description: Est. 1845, oldest commercial thermal resort in NZ. Closed since 2018.

properties.name: Palm Springs Geothermal Pools
properties.description: Paid geothermal pool complex in Parakai, one hour northwest of Auckland

properties.name: Parakai Springs
properties.description: Kaipatiki Hot Springs (formerly Parakai), est. 1922. $24 adult, $14 child.

properties.name: Kaitoke Hot Springs
properties.description: Free natural hot spring pools on Great Barrier Island, 40-minute walk through wetland bush

properties.name: The Lost Spring
properties.description: Est. 2008, boutique thermal complex. 660m artesian bore tapping thermal aquifer.

properties.name: Hot Water Beach
properties.address: East Coast of Coromandel Peninsula, Hahei
properties.description: Dig your own hot pool in the sand at low tide. Visit within 2 hours of low tide.

properties.name: Hot Water Beach TOP 10 Holiday Park
Swimzone Te Aroha
properties.address: Te Aroha Hot Springs Domain, Boundary Street, Te Aroha

properties.name: Te Aroha Holiday Park and Hot Pools
Te Aroha Mineral Spas
properties.address: Te Aroha Hot Springs Domain, Boundary Street, Te Aroha
properties.description: Est. 1882. NZ's only soda-water spa. Heritage-listed Edwardian bathhouse. Sodium bicarbonate-rich, naturally carbonated.

properties.name: Miranda Holiday Park
properties.address: 595 Front Miranda Road, Waitakaruru RD6 Thames

properties.name: Miranda Hot Springs
properties.description: Est. 1962. Closed. Near Pukorokoro Miranda Shorebird Centre and Firth of Thames Ramsar wetland.

properties.name: Kawhia Springs (Te Puia Springs)
properties.description: Dig your own hot pool at low tide on black sand beach. West coast, much quieter than Coromandel.

properties.name: Waingaro Hot Springs
properties.description: Est. 1956. Naturally thermal water at 41C source. Holiday park with camping, cabins, motel. 30 min from Hamilton or Raglan.

properties.name: Okoroire Hot Springs Hotel
properties.description: Est. 1889. Heritage Victorian-era stone walls. Outdoor pool in fern grove.

properties.name: Opal Hot Springs and Holiday Park
properties.description: Est. 1957. Family destination. 15 min from Hobbiton Movie Set.

properties.name: Mount Maunganui Hot Salt Water Pools
properties.description: Est. 1928. Saltwater thermal - warm seawater from thermally-elevated aquifer. At base of Mauao.

properties.name: Oropi Hot Pools, Cafe & Beauty Spa
Athenree Hot Springs and Holiday Park
Plummers Point Caravan Park and Hot Mineral Pools
Welcome Bay Hot Pools and Holiday Park
Omokoroa Tourist Park and Thermal Hot Pools
Morere Hot Springs (Nga Hua o Morere)
properties.description: Est. 1895. 364-hectare DOC reserve of native lowland forest.

properties.name: Te Puia Springs Hotel
properties.description: Heritage hotel on SH35 near Tokomaru Bay, est. 1918. Natural mineral hot pool free for guests.

properties.name: Waikite Valley Thermal Pools
properties.address: Waikite Valley, between Rotorua and Taupo
properties.description: Est. 1972. Fed by Te Manaroa Spring - largest single boiling spring in NZ by volume (30L/sec at 100C).

properties.name: Polynesian Spa
properties.description: Est. 1972. Priest Spring used since 1860s. 28 mineral pools. Sulphate-chloride and bicarbonate mineral content.

properties.name: Wai Ariki Hot Springs & Spa
properties.description: Paid adult-only luxury Maori cultural spa on Lake Rotorua. Geothermal mineral pools, mud therapy, saunas.

properties.name: Secret Spot Hot Tubs
properties.description: Private cedar hot tubs in native forest beside Puarenga Stream. Cafe, bar, saunas, cold plunge tubs.

properties.name: Hell's Gate - WaiOra Spa and Wellness Centre
properties.address: State Highway 30, Tikitere, 10km north of Rotorua
properties.description: Est. 1990. Owned by Ngati Rangiteaorere. Kakahi Falls - southern hemisphere's largest hot waterfall. Mud baths.

properties.name: Wai-O-Tapu Thermal Wonderland
properties.description: Visual geothermal park. Champagne Pool, Devil's Bath, Lady Knox Geyser. No swimming - too acidic and hot.

properties.name: The Bridge (Secret Spot, HotnCold), Waiotapu Stream
Kerosene Creek
properties.address: 35km south of Rotorua on way to Taupo
properties.description: Free natural geothermal stream and waterfall pool. Bush-fringed. Don't put head under (amoebic meningitis risk).
properties.geocode_note: Google geocode returned approximate location; ref_coords used instead

properties.name: Lake Rotowhero
properties.description: Small geothermal lake heated by submerged hot springs. Sulphurous yellow-green tint.

properties.name: Kuirau Park Footbaths
properties.description: Free public thermal foot baths in Kuirau Park, central Rotorua.

properties.name: Maungataniwha Hot Springs
properties.address: Western part of Te Urewera National Park

properties.name: Te Rata Bay (Hot Water Beach, Lake Tarawera)
properties.description: Geothermal seeps from post-1886 Tarawera eruption. Boat access only. Water taxi from Tarawera Landing.

properties.name: Maurie Kjar Memorial Swimming Pool Complex
Lake Rotoiti Hot Pools (Manupirua Thermal Springs)
properties.description: Accessible only by boat from Okere Falls. Used by Te Arawa for centuries.

properties.name: Hinemoa's Pool (Wai-Kimihia)
properties.description: Culturally significant site. Hinemoa swam across Lake Rotorua to find Tutanekai. Visits by booked tour with Te Arawa kaitiaki.

properties.name: A.C. Baths
properties.address: Cnr Spa Road and A.C. Baths Avenue, Taupo

properties.name: Tokaanu Thermal Pools
properties.description: Paid geothermal pools on southern shore of Lake Taupo. Private mineral pools, public pool, free thermal bushwalk.

properties.name: Butchers Pool
properties.address: Northeast of Golden Springs, near Reporoa

properties.name: Otumuheke Stream, Spa Park
properties.description: Hot creek meets cold Waikato River. Natural rock pools and waterfall. Changing rooms and cafe on site.

properties.name: Taupo DeBretts Hot Springs
properties.description: Est. 1881. Thermal pools, hydroslides, holiday park. Easy walk to Taupo centre.

properties.name: Wairakei Terraces
properties.description: Paid adult-only geothermal spa. Three mineral pools below man-made silica terraces. Ages 14 and over.

properties.name: Golden Springs Motel and Holiday Park
The Honeymoon Pool (Te Kiri O Hine Kai Stream)
Craters of the Moon geothermal area
properties.description: Geothermal walkway with steaming craters and mud pools. No bathing.

properties.name: Mangatutu Hot Springs
properties.address: Kaweka Forest Park, Northwest of Napier
properties.description: Two free geothermal tubs beside the Mohaka River in Kaweka Forest Park. About 90 minutes from Napier on rough gravel. DOC campsite adjacent.

properties.name: Mangatainoka Hot Springs
properties.address: Te Whaiti / Ureweras, up the Mohaka River
properties.description: Three renovated geothermal pools in Kaweka Forest Park, 3-4 hour intermediate tramp. DOC campsite adjacent.

properties.name: Waipiropiro Hot Spring
properties.address: Between Taihape and Napier, Taihape Road

properties.name: Mungo River Hot Springs
properties.address: In the heart of the Southern Alps

properties.name: Deception River Hot Springs
properties.address: Deception River, Arthur's Pass National Park

properties.name: Amethyst Hot Springs, Lower Wanganui River
Hot Spring Flat, Mid Wanganui River
Smythe Hut Hot Spring, Upper Wanganui River
Welcome Flat Hot Pools
properties.description: 7-hour Copland Track tramp. Calcium-bicarbonate-rich pools with white travertine terraces. DOC hut sleeps 31.
properties.geocode_note: Google geocode returned approximate location; ref_coords used instead

properties.name: Wren Creek Hot Springs, Cedar Flats
Maruia Springs Thermal Resort
properties.description: Est. 1976. Alpine wellness retreat on Lewis Pass highway. Open-air alpine pools facing Maruia River. Private bathhouses, sauna, accommodation.
properties.geocode_note: Google geocode returned approximate location; ref_coords used instead

properties.name: He Puna Taimoana
properties.description: Est. 2020. Christchurch's only hot saltwater pool facility. Five-pool complex on New Brighton foreshore facing Pacific.

properties.name: Opuke Thermal Pools & Spa
properties.description: Est. 2021. Largest new NZ thermal complex of post-2020 era. Solar-heated. Alpine setting looking up at Mt Hutt.

properties.name: Horseshoe Hot Springs
properties.address: 3km downstream of where SH 7 crosses Hope River

properties.name: Cow Stream Hot Spring, Hanmer Springs
properties.address: North of Hanmer Forest Park, Hanmer Springs
properties.description: Most-known wilderness pool in Hanmer Springs area. Small pool fits 2-3 people. Informal track, not signposted.

properties.name: Hurunui River (North Branch) Hot Springs
properties.address: Hurunui River, North of Lake Taylor, Lake Sumner Forest Park
properties.description: Accessed via Lake Sumner/Hurunui Tramping Track. 5-6 hours from road end. Hurunui Hut (DOC) is night-stop.

properties.name: Sylvia Flats Hot Springs
properties.address: State Highway 7, 15km south of Lewis Pass
properties.description: Destroyed by slip 20 Jan 2017. Was most accessible South Island wilderness hot pool - 5 min walk from SH7 Lewis Pass.

properties.name: Hurunui River (South Branch) Hot Springs
properties.address: Hurunui River, South of Lake Taylor

properties.name: Hanmer Springs Thermal Reserve
properties.address: Corner Jacks Pass Road & Amuri Avenue, Hanmer Springs
properties.description: Est. 1883. 22 alpine geothermal pools, waterslides, sulphur pools, steam rooms, day spa. 90 min from Christchurch.

properties.name: Tekapo Springs
properties.description: Est. 2007. Heated freshwater (not naturally thermal). Lake Tekapo / Aoraki views. Ice skating and snow tubing in winter.

properties.name: Onsen Hot Pools
properties.address: 160 Arthurs Point Rd, Arthurs Point, Queenstown
properties.description: Est. 2014. Private cedar tubs over Shotover Canyon. Heated water (not naturally thermal). Booking required.

properties.name: Murray's Beach hot pool
properties.description: Southernmost natural hot spring in NZ. Walk-in only, small pool, not consistently warm.

properties.name: Butlers Hot Springs
properties.address: Mt Aspiring National Park, Routeburn area
properties.description: Multi-day off-track tramp in Mt Aspiring National Park. Lukewarm seep. Not for casual visitors.

properties.name: Frying Pan Lake (Waimangu Cauldron)
properties.address: Waimangu Volcanic Rift Valley, near Rotorua
properties.description: World's largest hot spring. Part of Waimangu Volcanic Rift Valley. No bathing.

properties.name: Ketetahi Springs
properties.address: Tongariro National Park, near Mount Ruapehu
properties.description: Geothermal springs on the Tongariro Alpine Crossing. Private land, no bathing.
